summary.text: Wade Williams is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 4 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is running unopposed for re-election on November 3, 2026. Ballotpedia lists him as D. Wade Williams, a healthcare administrator and former police chief of Madisonville, Kentucky.

paragraphs.text: Williams served in the U.S. Army and U.S. Army Reserve.
He earned a B.S. in organizational management from Oakland City University in 2001 and an M.P.A. from Murray State University.

His career experience includes working as executive director of Baptist Health System Kentucky and Indiana, program manager of Groves Electrical Services, and chief of police of Madisonville, Kentucky.
Williams succeeded Republican Lynn Bechler in District 4.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Appropriations and Revenue, House Judiciary, House Natural Resources and Energy, and House State Government committees.
